author: Tethium
body:
Application

Age: 23
Timezone: GMT-3
Do you have access to TeamSpeak? Yes/No: Yes
Do you have access to Skype? Yes/No: Yes
Do you have access to a recording software? Yes/No: Yes

CRITERIA 1: SELF REFLECTION/EVALUATION

Do you have any experience as a staff member on any servers?

I was moderator on a Chilean server for 2 years, I was moderator for 7 months on a potpvp server.

What is your biggest weakness and how do you believe it will affect your moderating? What is your biggest strength and how would this affect your moderating?

My weakness is that I'm very strict with the subject of hacks / ghost client and sometimes I don't allow the person sanctioned to be defended, but it is a weakness that doesnt negatively influence my work as moderator. My greatest strength is that I am a committed and responsible person with my role.

How do you believe you can help improve the Staff Team?

An older person can always bring wisdom and calm to a group, helping to make important decisions.

What qualities does a leader need to have in your opinion? Do you consider yourself to be a leader? Why?

A leader shouldnt be a person who is above the other staff members, must be a person who fulfills a role of guide, who sees in all its members an element of contribution, that can give security to other people. Being jr moderator means learning from a leader, therefore I have many things to learn on this server.

What attributes distinguish yourself from other players that qualify you to be a moderator?

Basically my age gives the assurance that I am a reliable and responsible person with my work, that I fully understand the importance of moderating a server.

What skills do you believe you should have when interacting with the community? Do you believe you have these skills?

Be empathetic and a sympathetic person with the other members of the community, knowing that they are an important part of the server who also deserve respect. Yes, for sure.


How much time can you commit to being a staff member (Rough Idea)? 

I'm a relatively active person, I can connect every day of the week after 4 in the afternoon (because I work as a history teacher), but I can seriously commit to this work.


CRITERIA 2: GENERAL SITUATIONS

You are currently undergoing your junior moderator trial. A ban evader is online and he is constantly ban evading and hacking. You are the only one online and the only one who is able to be online. What would you do?

If that person has constantly violated the rules of the server (by hacking or ban evasion) I think the best decision would be to review the profile of the person and see their sanctions to subsequently apply ban.

Another staff member is constantly joining and harassing other people on Teamspeak in their team channel. The staff member is also referee and has physical permissions to be in that channel. However the leaders do not want this staff member in there and they have asked him to leave multiple times. What would you do?

I would tell him to remember that he has a role to play and that he has been assigned a job that he is not fulfilling, I think that to remind him that element so basic could make this member of staff do not continue making that mistake.


A player appeals a punishment you gave them. You realise that the evidence file is corrupted and therefore there is no physical evidence. You know however this person did indeed break the rules, what would you do?

A good moderator not only collects a single evidence, but must be sure to have plenty of evidence before applying the penalty to avoid situations like this.

You are in an Avicus team. One of your teammates is also an Avicus Staff member. One day in your team discord the team member/staff member posts a screenshot of a thread that only staff members can see. The content in the screenshot isn’t very important/confident but only staff members could see it on the forums. If anything, what would you do?

If the protocol indicates that these photos can only be seen by staff members, I must comply with that rule and not share that evidence with anyone else, regardless of whether that evidence is important or not.

One day the Senior Staff team makes a decision you do not agree with. You do not know all the details of the decision or the circumstances in which they were made and you were simply told by another staff member. However you do not like the decision based from what you know. What would you do?

As a jr.moderator I always have to ask about the decisions that are being made to be informed, and asking the most important members of the staff allows me to be sure that this information is reliable and safe.

CRITERIA 3: OTHER
NOTE: This is a new criteria and these questions are less to do with right/wrong answer and more to do with us getting to know you. Please answer these honestly. There is no right or wrong answer.


What would getting moderator on Avicus mean to you?

An interesting experience that I would like to live within this community.

How passionate are you about Avicus? What does Avicus mean to you?

Since octc is closed, avicus is the main stage for tournaments within this competitive minecraft community, therefore avicus needs members to contribute in a positive way.


Do you speak any other languages than English?

No, just english.


Do you have anything else to add to your application?

Thank you very much for your time, I hope to be able to contribute in the best way to this server.
